title: Projectivity after scalar extension
statement: Let $R_0\to R$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $P$ be a projective $R_0$-module. Then the scalar extension $R\otimes_{R_0}P$ is a projective $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module].
